title: Gene Krupa Plays Gerry Mulligan Arrangements
studio_context: Mulligan's charts for Krupa's 1940s band, remade with a studio big band; Disc Jockey Jump is on The Best of Gene Krupa.

drum_performances.name: Gene Krupa
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Disc Jockey Jump's sixteen-bar solo in triplets over four on the bass drum, as Rupert Kettle transcribed it.
